connector.name: Amendor
connector.registryDescription: Pull change requests from your Amendor board into your coding agent to build and open PRs.
connector.summary: Hosted at amendor.site over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package amendor-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the deslay1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: AMENDOR_TOKEN
env.description: Connector token from amendor.site/settings (generated per account)
